# Make Archive

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Makes an archive of the given file.

## Syntax

~~~~text
makeArchive(input: <#Variable (Optional)#>, type: <#Enumeration (WFArchiveFormat)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
makeArchive(input: ShortcutInput, type: .zip)
~~~~
